comment: Scheduler tasks whose authority is not yet settled in code. Generated by bun scripts/queue-authority.ts --write; shrink-only. Keys: task:<name>::run-actor (a member-run task that does not settle its member's access when it runs), task:<name>::pinned-handles::<file> (a member-run task module the pinned-workspace-handles allowlist admits), task:<name>::unclassified (the code does not settle who the task acts for).

members.task:scheduler.dispatchBullMq::unclassif: Forwards to whichever queue a stored job names; the code does not fix the target queue, so the authority depends on data.
